bufferRequestsAfterDispose.scope: Observed bufferData requests minus replacement/deleteBuffer calls, after probe installation. WebGL errors are not polled. Excludes textures, programs, driver caches, JavaScript heap, earlier allocations and implicit context-loss release. Binding queries add QA overhead; do not use this run for frametime comparisons.

scope: Requested-buffer ownership QA only: binding queries perturb scheduling; ignore frame/timing summaries for performance comparison.
